_comment: Copy this file to mining/miner_secrets.json and fill in real values. Never commit miner_secrets.json.
_comment_note: A basic miner (MinerRestServer on port 8088, started automatically by neurons/miner.py) does NOT read this file at all -- its auth uses vanta_api/api_keys.json instead (see vanta_api/api_keys_example.json). Everything below is only read when running with --entity-miner.
_comment_required_entity_miner: Required for --entity-miner: wallet_* build the coldkey/hotkey used to sign subaccount creation, validator_url is where create-subaccount requests are sent (see docs/entity_miner.md, docs/entity_miner_rest_server.md).
_comment_required_for_dashboard_streamin: Required only for the real-time subaccount dashboard WebSocket stream; subaccount creation itself still works without these.
_comment_optional_usdc_auto_payouts: Only used when enable_auto_payouts is true (see 'USDC Payment Daemon' in docs/entity_miner_rest_server.md). usdc_rpc_url has no working built-in default -- set it explicitly.
_comment_deprecated: api_key below is read only by the deprecated legacy mining/run_receive_signals_server.py. Not used by MinerRestServer or EntityMinerRestServer.
